clean_dimensions: No clipped text, overflow, overlap, malformed glyph, broken rule, broken whisker, or page-edge cutoff was observed on any slide.
No load-bearing title, message, chart label, series distinction, stage label, or result annotation failed the reduced-view legibility check.
Slides 8, 9, and 10 visually support the sentence printed above each chart without materially overstating the estimates.

On slides 9 and 10, categorical event stages are explicitly named, their pooled windows are described, and event separators make the connected points read as ordered stages rather than equal-duration continuous time.
On slide 9, separate axes, outcome labels, and panel headings adequately prevent visual-height comparison between residual uncertainty and cash ratio.
Coefficient labels, standard errors, significance markers, confidence intervals, and Wald brackets on slides 8, 9, and 10 attach to the intended estimate, series, stage, and panel.
Accent colour and weight are used consistently as focal emphasis, with grey reserved for secondary structure, baselines, or comparison series.
The intended first-look hierarchy is preserved on all 13 slides.
operator_should_check_locally: Actual back-row legibility can still vary with room size, projector brightness, focus, and ambient light; those physical conditions were not available in the source-closed review.

limitations: The review was source-closed and did not verify numerical values, wording, citations, or thesis claims outside the supplied visual-audit brief.
No pixel measurement or coordinate inference was used.
The SHA-256 value for audit_visual_response.json is calculated from the exact UTF-8 file with its own sha256 field replaced by 64 zero characters; this avoids an impossible self-referential hash.
